entities.name: Sinnia
entities.description: A human from Innistrad who took part in Harvesttide and fell foul of the witch Saryth when she wore a mysterious mask.

entities.name: Leinore
entities.description: Sinnia's sister, who destroyed the mask.

entities.name: Saryth
entities.description: Evil witch tied to the mask.

entities.name: Coiled One
entities.description: Giant serpent tied to the mask that held Sinnia.

events.summary: Sinnia finds a mysterious mask and wears it despite warnings, becoming charismatic and influential.
events.quote: Sinnia discovered a mysterious mask and decided to wear it despite warnings.

events.summary: Leinore destroys the mask; the serpent releases Sinnia and returns underground.
events.quote: Leinore managed to destroy the mask, which made the serpent release its hold on Sinnia and send it back below ground.

relations.quote: often teasing her sister Leinore with kindness

relations.note: the mask was tied to both
relations.quote: the mask proved to be tied to the evil witch Saryth and the giant serpent known as the Coiled One
